Spirit Sweep

GHOST-CLEANING VR HORROR · META QUEST

Enter the haunting. Wield the relic. Purge the estate.

A first-person VR ghost hunt through a decayed Victorian estate. Armed with the Spirit Sweeper — an engraved arcane cannon — you scan, stun, weaken and pull spirits into your containment vortex before your protective barrier shatters.

  • 10 missions across 3 haunted zones linked by dimensional portals
  • 16 spirit types — Ash-Cloaked Reapers, Hellfire Banshees, Frostwights, Mimic Puppets and more, each with its own attacks
  • One tool, four moves — scanner pulse, stun burst, dual-helix exorcism beam, containment vortex
  • Boss Housekeeper finale — cleanse 3 cursed keepsakes to strip her immunity and banish her
Get it on Meta Horizon Store Watch the Short ↗ SEATED OR STANDING · SINGLE PLAYER
LIVE · META HORIZON STORE

Neon Katana

VR RHYTHM GAME · META QUEST 2 & QUEST 3

Slice neon blocks to the beat with dual glowing katanas.

A katana-slicing rhythm game for Beat Saber fans with its own identity: dual katanas instead of sabers, a signature iaijutsu draw-slash, and neon ronin duels where you parry and counter between songs. The arena itself pulses with the music.

  • Dual-wield katana slicing — match red and blue targets to the correct blade, direction and timing matter
  • Iaijutsu draw-slash — draw and cut in one motion for massive score; a mechanic no other rhythm game has
  • Parry & counter duels — rhythmic neon ronin showdowns woven into the tracks
  • D-to-SSS rank ladder — a real skill grade to chase on every track
Get it on Meta Horizon Store $11.99 · ONE-TIME PURCHASE · NO PC REQUIRED
